title: Start menu search history
whyItMatters: WordWheelQuery records terms typed into the Start menu search box, which can reveal what the user was looking for.
notes: Search terms are not read. The MRU ordering and value data are out of scope; only existence and counts are recorded.

steps: Only if you are not doing the full reset at the end of this plan, and you are comfortable with Registry Editor:
Open Registry Editor and go to the key named in the plan.
Delete the values in that key but keep the key itself; this empties the search history.
cleanup.risk: Removes the Start menu search history for this account. Windows starts a new list on the next search.
